registration.input: projectedCellCenter already includes original map Level * 15 native pixels.
registration.formula: offsetFromCellCenter = rawLayerOffset - isometricSourceSubTileGridOffset - (30,15). Map.Level already includes templateHeight; never subtract templateHeight again.
registration.diamond: All 1179 source header offsets equal their source subtile grid offsets; therefore every diamond is centered at (-30,-15). Extra layers retain exact original offsets.
registration.height: Source templateHeight and raw map Level are retained separately. Source template maxHeight assembly adjustment is not applied after a per-cell Level projection.
registration.foreground: Base draws diamond then exact native extra. Foreground helper draws only extra by default, with optional original top; caller selects genuinely higher/front cells and excludes subject cell.
registration.pixels: Native palette index0 is transparent in diamonds and extras. No mesh warp, color replacement, synthetic wall, rescaling of source pixels, or terrain guessing.
